By combining it with the chimney starter, I now can go from pouring the charcoal to ready to cook in a little over 5 minutes! And cooking is now a breeze. The superior heat distribution allows for full use of the entire large cooking area. And the food cooks so much better with more consistent/hotter temps. All in all I love everything about this grill and wish I’d have made the switch years earlier. All grills are not created equal!

Follow the directions in the owners guide for charcoal quantities, pre-heating, vent settings, and cook time and you won't go wrong.  If this is going to be your only grill, I would buy the larger unit. Two large cast iron skillets won't both fit on the 22" at the same time. I would recommend this product no matter your level of outdoor cooking experience.

Results.ReviewText: This grill lives up to the legend.  It is easy to use and versatile beyond my imaginings.  I can grill, sear, slow-smoke, direct cook, indirect cook.  My Weber does it all.  It is feature packed, with hinged food grate, the one touch cleaning system and a thermometer in the lid that, while not a deal breaker if it was not there, is handy.  I grill without fear now.  Secure in the knowledge that when I need a part or accessory, I can find them with ease at my local hardware stores...  like all of them.  Pick one, they have it.  And charcoal is everywhere, anytime.  Even at the all-night convenience store, if I were ever to find myself in dire need.  Get one. Don't look back You will not regret it.

I purchased my grill about 45 days ago.  I have used propane grills for years, and had forgotten how wonderful charcoal grills are.  
Everything I have grilled so far has come out at, or very near, perfect!
Want a treat?  Babybacks, pressure cooked about 14 minutes, soak them in sauce, then grill them on your super cool Weber.  Oh.... Yeah....   The texture of bbq with charcoal, is the absolute bomb!
My only problem.  We had a storm last week and the wind caught the cover and tossed it across the yard, into a retaining wall.  It put a small dent in the rim, and knocked about an inch square patch of the ceramic coating off.  Bummer!

But I still love my baby!

Unfortunately, I had to disassemble, return it to the store, and come to find out, they don't sell them anymore! So a lot of hassle and in the end, no grill. I recently bought a new 22" Kettle as a replacement for my old Weber kettle as I did not want to move the old grill.  As my last kettle was over 8 years old, I noticed several improvements made on the new model: The heat shield on the lid handle, integral thermometer - don't have to add one myself!, the ash catcher is much easier to remove and replace.  Overall a great product!

The reason for only 4 stars (and 3 stars for design) is due to the placement of the lid catch.  On prior models, this was placed in line with the lid handle.  My new one is now perpendicular, which makes it a bit awkward to latch the lid on the side of the kettle when checking/basting/turning.

Results.ReviewText: The product has a great set of features and after having the new removable ash pan design it really is hard to go back to anything else.  The grate with the flip up sides is also a great addition.  Given that it is the "premium" I really would have liked to see some kind of plastic tab on the top vent though.  It is something that would have cost pennies to add and is a real safety issue as it will get super hot during a cook.  The vent control also really needs to have some kind of indicator that tells you how far the vents are open or closed.  I plan on fixing this at some point with grinding some symbols on it so you can actually see if they are open, closed, or half open.

Results.ReviewText: For the longest time I was a gas grill guy. Was a bit timid using charcoal so I started with a cheap rump roast to break in my charcoal use. What an experience!! Got a nice dark crust on the outer and moved it off heat for the remainder to get temp to 130. It was perfect!! This Weber is amazing!! Making a professional griller out of a beginner. Results.Title: First charcoal

Results.ReviewText:
In life, there are some things that just "work".  Weber Charcoal Grills & Smokers are the poster children for that concept. Well built, well supported, priced reasonably. They are not cheap, but they're not junk. A 10 year warranty is usually a good sign of well engineered products.  
If you ever have an issue with a purchase, you call Weber, they take care of it.
Post-sale customer support is second to none.
Results.Title: Best of the Breed

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
